about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash EXL3 3.0bpw on one RTX 3090: all routed experts pinned in RAM, staged-DMA prefill with FP16 GEMM for busy experts, AVX2 CPU tier for decode misses, elastic VRAM expert cache, Engram tables mmap'd from NVMe (dsv41-flash-offload 5776abf, campaign run D118)
setup: NEEDS: 1x RTX 3090 24 GB (the VRAM expert mirror cache takes the VRAM left after load minus 900 MB; nothing else may use the GPU); ~231 GB (215 GiB) of free system RAM (MemAvailable fell 213.8 / 210.8 / 209.9 / 211.0 GB from container start to ready in campaign runs D030 / D061 / D107 / D117, all routed experts pinned: 190.5 GiB; the lowest point under the lab gates is not measured, the entrypoint requires 215 GiB); an x86-64 CPU with AVX2+FMA+F16C and >= 24 cores (CPU expert tier pinned to cores 2-23, 22 threads: DSV41_CT_CPUS / DSV41_CT_THREADS); 425 GB on a local NVMe SSD (Mia EXL3 3.0bpw 219.3 GB + the two Engram shards of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 203.1 GB, read on demand while serving + a 2.9 GB overlay pack); run with --cap-add IPC_LOCK --ulimit memlock=-1. ONE-TIME PACK: with both weight dirs under one root mounted read-write at /models, run the image with the single argument `prepare` (GPU, a few minutes): it builds /models/DSV41-EXL3-3090-D010 (symlinks into the two weight dirs, FP16 wo_a and compressor/indexer projections, text-only V4.1 config, host-plan.json) and checks it against the measured pack's sha256 (pack/expected-sha256.json); serving then mounts /models read-only. IMAGE: not published yet; build docker/Dockerfile of the source at this commit (pins lazymio/vllm-backport v0.13.0 by digest + Ampere V4.1 patches fae324ae + exllamav3 5be88657 + vllm-exl3 d3cfd394, runtime patches checked against the measured runs' sha256 receipts). ghcr.io/0xsero/dsv41-flash-offload from 0xSero/local-ai-images#12 replaces this build with a digest + provenance after merge and a release-image run on main. MEASURED (campaign, P2 sweep: prefill = median of 3 random-token prompts; decode = greedy to natural end, aggregate, median of 2 rounds; all at --max-model-len 65536, KV 1 GiB fp8; EPYC 7443P, 503 GiB DDR4, PCIe 4.0 x16, 990 PRO): D117 = this launch's sources and flags with the non-elastic cache (captured 2026-10-02T12:41+02:00, sweep still running): prefill 8k 575.2 / 32k 765.5 tok/s, decode C1 15.55, C2 17.74 agg (results/D117/sweep.json); D061 (prefill path only) 565.2 / 744.9 (results/D061/sweep.json); D107 (1,024-token chunks, best decode) C1 21.34 / C2 26.27 / C4 28.30 agg, prefill 96.9 / 98.6 (results/D107/sweep.json); D030 baseline (zero-copy experts, no CPU tier) prefill 93.4 / 95.8, decode C1 4.10 (results/D030/sweep.json). D118 = this launch (DSV41_EC_ELASTIC=1): PENDING. QUALITY: prefill of the staged-DMA path vs the D026 full-vocabulary reference (12 prompts, 416 positions): top-1 0.9856, mean KL 0.0068 nats, median 2.8e-6 - fails the campaign's inherited guard (top-1 >= 0.988, KL <= 0.00103); EXL3_DMA_GEMM=0 is the slower segmented path (results/D061/fidelity-verdict.json). NOT VALIDATED: --max-model-len 262144 with --kv-cache-memory 4.5 GiB (at 16k chunks 1 GiB sized to 65,974 tokens); the lab gates (load chat reasoning tools context speed) have not run; the deepseek_v41 tool and reasoning parsers are configured, not verified on this stack. Reproduce the measured config with DSV41_MAX_MODEL_LEN=65536 DSV41_KV_CACHE_BYTES=1073741824.
